source.title: Oh No Ye Don't!
source.description:
Great job with the hammer, <class>. Next up is me armor. Definitely need that back to move on to the great beyond.

Only problem is it's in the eh... innards o' one of them 'bominations. I know, I know, it's askin' a lot, but ye gotta understand I was once a mighty thane under the mountain. I simply can't move on knowin' that the ancestral armor of me clan is dissolving in the gutjuice of a giant rotting mountain o' meat!
source.objective: Orthas needs you to recover his missing armor from the corpse of an Abomination somewhere in Plaguewood.
source.completion:
Oh that's nice! A little worse for wear but that'll do. We've one last thing needs doin'. I need a wee ritual. Just something tae put me scrambled spirit back together and send me on me way. This last part might be a bit discomfortin' for ye, bein a <class> and all, but trust me, it needs doin'!

At least it probably won't be more unsavory than fishin' around for me britches in abomination soup! Gwahaha!
